item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Avni's electromagnet: a coil of insulated copper wire on an iron nail joined to a cell. Ends of the nail are labelled P and Q. A magnetic compass is held near end P; the north pole of the compass needle is attracted towards P.

Which claim about the poles is correct?

options.A: With the cell disconnected, end P is still a South pole and end Q is still a North pole.
options.B: End P is a North pole and end Q is a South pole.
options.C: End P is a South pole and end Q is a North pole.
options.D: Both ends P and Q are South poles.
